body.p: , after , , . New part src/function_library_hash.c (fn:hash) over src/hash.c / src/hash_internal.h; rows added to the uri part (decode-from-uri, parse-uri, build-uri) and the qname part (parse-QName, resolve-QName).

item.p: Hashes: MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, BLAKE3 (the draft keeps it) and CRC-32 as one call sxml_hash_compute (algorithm, message view) into a fixed 32-octet sxml_digest: no allocation, no state; BLAKE3 merges chunk chaining values with a 54-entry stack (no recursion). The effective name is fn:upper-case(fn:normalize-space()) with Unicode case mapping, matched byte for byte; anything else is FOHA0001. No options are defined, so any unqualified key is XPTY0004. One step per 64 octets.

fn:parse-uri follows F&O 4.0, 7.6.2 step by step; each regular expression is matched by hand over the octets (no regex per call). The parts are views into one working copy (backslashes made slashes) and one rewritten copy for a drive letter. Implementation-defined: known hierarchical schemes are file, ftp, http, https; a port that is not 1 to 18 digits is left out (the field is xs:integer?); a zero-length authority (////host) is the empty sequence, as QT4 fn-parse-uri-048b/049b expect. query-parameters keeps keys in first-appearance order with all values; repeated keys are chained through an index map (O(n log n), not quadratic). The result is an annotated fn:uri-structure-record ().

Percent decoding (glossary): one octet reader for decode-from-uri, parse-uri (URI decoding) and query parameters (form decoding, + as space); broken escapes take % and up to two octets (QT4 %üü is U+FFFD then ü); UTF-8 breaks off at the first octet outside Unicode's well-formed ranges; U+0000, U+FFFE, U+FFFF become U+FFFD.

fn:build-uri reuses the escaping table of encode-for-uri (three new kinds: path segment, query parameter, fragment). Deviation: a URI without a scheme gets // before an authority (the spec text adds nothing, which would make {'host': 'x', 'path': '/p'} read back as a path); an empty query (from an empty map) adds no ?.

fn:parse-QName is marked USES_DYNAMIC_CONTEXT so no pass folds it: prefix:local is the xs:QName cast with the static namespaces of sxml_dynamic_context_get_running_unit (; FONS0004 from the cast, predeclared prefixes included); NCName and Q{uri}local are made directly; FOCA0002 for the rest. fn:resolve-QName looks the prefix up in the element's in-scope namespaces only (no predeclared fallback: xs:x on <a/> is FONS0004).

Measured (release driver, XP40, passed of cases): fn-parse-uri 0 to 74/74, fn-build-uri 0 to 48/48, fn-decode-from-uri 0 to 29/29, fn-parse-QName 6 (all wrong errors) to 19/19, fn-resolve-QName 4 to 8/8 run (23 XQuery-only), fn-hash 1 to 54/54.
